verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents strong bidirectional integration for Slack (incident management, PIRs initiated from Slack) and GitHub (SRE Agent analyzing code), plus generic webhooks/REST API/Events API infrastructure and a claim of '750+ platform integrations,' but Jira, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom are never named explicitly with concrete two-way state-sync details — only a conference-bridge reference for Scribe Agent hints at Zoom-like tooling. Missing for 10: explicit Jira integration docs, explicit Microsoft Teams integration docs, explicit Zoom integration docs, and confirmation that state truly flows both ways (not just PagerDuty-initiated) for each named tool.
